interpretation: This exact phase-fit window is a declared proxy; Bohé et al. 2017 Sec. IV.A does not specify it. A selected-case pass is not paper-equivalent or domain-wide qualification.
phase_alignment: Minimize RMS of unwrapped candidate-minus-NR phase over the early NR interval, after removing one constant phase. Evaluate candidate at NR time plus one time lag. No intrinsic-parameter or amplitude fit.
purpose: Secondary early-inspiral phase-aligned amplitude-peak timing diagnostic. Fixed while the five native comparisons were running, after the first unweighted row was available; not a fully blinded or paper-exact release gate.
reference_start: highest-resolution NR metadata relaxation_time on its raw clock, transformed by the fixed M omega_22=0.09 anchor
